treeview.comment: Read treeView-beta at the selected header position, with its following whitespace, percent-pair or end-of-input boundary. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and treeview.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read an authored branch prefix as a structural operator, retaining internal directives. Comment-shaped and metadata-shaped rows keep their ordinary reading. The rule recognizes branch rows without tracking the globally selected box mode. Follows treeview.md#columns-and-prefix-indentation and treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors.
Read non-whitespace authored prefix characters as structural operators rather than labels or annotations. Follows treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a class annotation as a separator and a referenced style-class name; keep directives in complete-component gaps. Follows treeview.md#annotations and treeview.md#comments-and-boundaries.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows treeview.md#comments-and-boundaries.
Read an icon annotation's keyword, icon brackets and retained reference text. Follows treeview.md#annotations.
Read a description annotation modifier followed by unquoted text through line end or a common-comment boundary. Follows treeview.md#annotations.

Read a double-quoted name without backslash escapes, applying decoration and common-comment rules to its interior lines. Follows treeview.md#names, treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors, and common.md#comment-lines.

Read a single-quoted name without backslash escapes, applying decoration and common-comment rules to its interior lines. Follows treeview.md#names, treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors, and common.md#comment-lines.
Read a native comment after ASCII padding at a line, header, quoted-name, icon or directive boundary. Follows treeview.md#comments-and-boundaries and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows treeview.md#comments-and-boundaries.

Read a bare name after its own indentation or directive boundary, leaving leading directives and quoted names for their rules. Follows treeview.md#names, treeview.md#columns-and-prefix-indentation, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

treeview-decoration.comment: Read box bars and whitespace as one decoration line, with directives anywhere between them and at least one bar outside directives. This leaves out the whole-tree mode test, so vertical-only lines are always decoration. Follows treeview.md#scope-and-mode, treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
treeview-decoration.name: comment.block.ignored.mermaid

treeview-quoted-double.comment: Read a double-quoted name without backslash escapes, applying decoration and common-comment rules to its interior lines. Follows treeview.md#names, treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors, and common.md#comment-lines.
treeview-quoted-double.name: string.quoted.double.mermaid

treeview-quoted-single.comment: Read a single-quoted name without backslash escapes, applying decoration and common-comment rules to its interior lines. Follows treeview.md#names, treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors, and common.md#comment-lines.
treeview-quoted-single.name: string.quoted.single.mermaid

treeview-acc-descr-block.comment: Read a braced accDescr value through its first closing brace, with independent decoration and common-comment lines inside its text. Follows treeview.md#common-forms, treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors, and common.md#comment-lines.

treeview-common-statements.comment: Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata, applying decoration rules inside a braced value. Follows treeview.md#common-forms and treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors.

treeview-prefixed-common-statements.comment: Read a leading box branch and its padding before common metadata. Consuming the prefix puts the common rules at the current scan position; after their form ends, following text returns to the surrounding tree rules. Vertical bars without a branch and additional branch marks do not enter this context. Follows treeview.md#line-classification-and-errors, treeview.md#common-forms, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

patterns.comment: Read non-padding prefix characters as structural operators, stopping before directives so they retain their own scopes. Follows treeview.md#columns-and-prefix-indentation and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.mermaid
